description: This file defines various data classes and models for runner session argument types used in a development runner, including configurations for dial-in settings, daily dial-in requests, and different transport session arguments such as WebSocket and WebRTC.

classes.name: DialinSettings
classes.description: Model for dial-in settings received from Daily webhook, including call identifiers and SIP headers.

classes.name: DailyDialinRequest
classes.description: Model for daily PSTN dial-in request data, including dial-in settings and API credentials.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Base class for runner session arguments, with common timeout and signal handling attributes.

classes.name: DailyRunnerArguments
classes.description: Derived class for daily transport session arguments, including room URL and token.

classes.name: WebSocketRunnerArguments
classes.description: Derived class for WebSocket transport session arguments, including WebSocket connection.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCRunnerArguments
classes.description: Derived class for WebRTC transport session arguments, including WebRTC connection object.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Initializes default values for signal handling and timeout after dataclass instantiation.
